global_iqr.desc: Price outside 1.5x IQR from dataset quartiles

psqm_town_flattype_z3.desc: Price/sqm z-score > 3.0 within same town + flat_type

assumptions: 99-year HDB lease assumed; remaining lease computed from lease_commence_date.
z-score threshold of 3.0 captures approximately 0.3% tail events under normality.
Peer groups use town + flat_type and flat_model independently.
Price per sqm normalises for unit size variation.
